Subject: Annual prepay invoicing and VAT evidence needed

Hi Marissa,

We're kicking off the procurement workstream for our committed Redwood engagement and need to align on the invoicing cadence and the VAT evidence you'll require. High-level asks from our side: 

- We'd like an invoice plan that lets us match your billed amounts to our fiscal milestones (we run quarterly forecasts).
- Please confirm what VAT documentation we need to supply and whether you require invoices per legal entity or a central invoice.
- Can you provide a sample invoice and a proposed schedule for an annual prepay (we're targeting ~EUR 1.2M committed spend)?

I've attached a quick entity worksheet with legal names and GL/PO contacts to help.

Attachments: ACME_entity_info.xlsx (xlsx)

Thanks,
Elena Petrova
Procurement Manager, ACME Health
procurement@acmehealth.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>

Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 09 May 2026 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Annual prepay invoicing and VAT evidence needed

Hi Elena — thanks for the worksheet and context. We're happy to propose a phased invoice approach that maps to your forecasting windows and minimizes month-to-month cashflow friction. Initial thoughts below; Kimberly (cc'd) will draft the line-level phasing and invoice numbers.

Proposed starting plan (high level):
- Activation / Onboarding invoice: 40% upfront at contract signature
- Quarterly tranches: 20% at Q1, 20% at Q2, 20% at Q3 (final 0% or small reconciliation in Q4)

Questions for you: 
1) Which legal entity should we bill (ACME Health Ltd. vs ACME Health EU Ops)? invoice-to legal name and VAT ID please.
2) Do you require separate invoices per country for VAT reclaim, or will a single EU invoice suffice (we can produce both if needed)?
3) Do you have a PO number now or will that follow?

I've attached an anonymized sample invoice so you can see numbering and line items. If you'd prefer a lighter upfront (25%) we can accommodate — we'll wait for Kimberly's draft.

Attachments: RW-annual-invoice-sample.pdf (pdf)

Best,
Marissa Cole
Head of Revenue Operations | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com
+1 415-555-0193

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>

Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 10 May 2026 08:30:00 -0700
Subject: Draft invoice phasing & VAT handling (for approval)

Hi Elena — looping in Karthik (finance) for approval on the schedule below. Based on Marissa's note and a 1.2M committed spend, here's a draft phasing we can convert into formal invoices: 

Draft phasing (EUR 1,200,000 example):
- Invoice 001 (Activation): EUR 300,000 (25%) — payable on signature
- Invoice 002 (Q1 tranche): EUR 300,000 (25%) — due 30 days after start of Q1
- Invoice 003 (Q2 tranche): EUR 300,000 (25%)
- Invoice 004 (Q3 tranche): EUR 300,000 (25%)

Notes on VAT: 
- If ACME is VAT-registered in the EU and provides a valid VAT reg certificate, we can zero-rate intra-EU B2B where applicable or apply reverse-charge — we'll need the certificate on file prior to issuing the first invoice.
- If you require invoices per legal entity/country (for local reclaim), we'll emit separate invoices per entity and include country-specific VAT lines. That will change invoice numbering slightly but not the cashflow profile.

Action items (proposed):
- Elena: confirm legal entity to invoice + VAT reg number + PO (if available)
- ACME: upload VAT cert to a shared Drive folder or attach to reply
- RDW: we'll draft the four invoices and circulate DocuSign envelope for signature after PO/entitlement is confirmed

Attachment: draft-invoice-schedule.csv (csv)

Karthik — can you confirm finance is okay with the 25/25/25/25 split versus the 40/20/20/20 option Marissa flagged?

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
Billing Ops Manager | Redwood Inference
kimberly.park@redwood.com

From: Elena Petrova <elena.petrova@acmehealth.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 11 May 2026 14:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Draft invoice phasing & VAT handling (for approval)

Marissa / Kimberly — thanks, this is helpful. A few clarifications: 

- We will be invoiced to: ACME Health Europe Ltd. (VAT: EU987654321). I've attached the VAT certificate and scanned company registry extract.
- We prefer the 25/25/25/25 phasing (spreads our cashflow more evenly).
- PO: we'll issue PO ACME-PO-2026-778 next business day and attach to the DocuSign envelope if possible.

Attachments: ACME_VAT_Certificate.pdf (pdf)

One operational ask: can you include a short reconciliation table on the final invoice showing committed vs. billed vs. remaining credit? Helps our accounting team.

On a separate note, is there a way to have your invoice reference our GL code on each line? We'll provide mapping in the PO.

Best,
Elena
Procurement Manager, ACME Health
